unlisted_practices: Automated self-retraining of seizure detection algorithms from patient feedback, with efficient expert review used for further fine-tuning
Bidirectional patient-initiated and agent-initiated conversations to personalize interactions with an implantable device

screen.reason: The study deploys and tests a novel prototype platform linking EEG and LLM agents to communicate bidirectionally with 13 inpatient epilepsy monitoring patients. Although safeguards are integrated in the system design, the study tests the feasibility/performance of the platform rather than isolating or comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
